subject: Post-demo follow-up: side-by-side probes & quality checks vs HyperscalerX
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@cloudwave.ai>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Follow-up and next probes after today's demo

Hi Sergio — thanks again for a clear demo today. High-level takeaways for us: Redwood's latency looked promising and the streaming behavior was clean, but we still need concrete, repeatable comparisons vs HyperscalerX for three areas before we take this to procurement:

- Model-quality (hallucination/factuality): we want a small, consistent prompt set run across both providers and a simple metric for hallucination rate on knowledge/date-sensitive prompts.
- Latency & tail behavior: p50/p95 for short (~32 tokens) and medium (~512 tokens) payloads under a simulated concurrency of 30 rps.
- Cost-per-inference estimate: ballpark token-based cost at production throughput (100M tokens/month).

We attached a starter prompt set (eval_prompt_set_v1.csv) with ~40 prompts; feel free to adjust. Can Redwood run the probes and share raw outputs + a short analysis? Timeline wise, we'd like results by EOB next Wednesday so we can feed into our buyer committee.

Also, a quick question on model variants: can you map the Redwood model name(s) you used to a closest HyperscalerX offering? That helps our engineering team validate fairness of the comparison.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick 20-min sync if that helps.

— Liam
CloudWave Solutions
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@cloudwave.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-18T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up and next probes after today's demo

Thanks Liam — great meeting. Appreciate the clear asks and the prompt set. Quick confirmation of scope and proposed plan:

1) Scope we will run
   - Quality: run your 40 prompts plus Redwood internal regression subset (~30 prompts that historically catch hallucinations). We'll compute a simple hallucination metric (binary per prompt), and also flag hallucination type (fabrication / wrong-entity / date error). Target: provide both raw outputs and a 1-page summary.

   - Latency: p50/p95 measured for payload sizes you suggested (32 / 512 tokens), under synthetic load at 30 rps sustained and 2 x 30-rps burst test. Include cold-start behavior and streaming vs single-chunk where applicable.

   - Cost estimate: we'll produce a tokenized cost model using your 100M tokens/month baseline and show unit costs (per-1k tokens) for both standard and quantized runs.

2) Model mapping
   - We'll run Redwood's rwd-medium and rwd-large (quantized and fp16 where available) and map to HyperscalerX 'hx-a2' & 'hx-a3' based on similar parameter / perf class. We'll include versions so you can audit.

3) Success criteria and thresholds (proposal)
   - Hallucination rate: Redwood should be within ±1.5 percentage points of HyperscalerX on the provided set to be considered parity for quality.
   - Latency: p95 should be no worse than 1.25x HyperscalerX for 32-token payloads; for 512 tokens the target is parity or better when using prefix caching.

4) Timeline & owners
   - Marissa: run quality probes and produce the one-page summary + raw output bundle. Deliverable due: 2027-04-21 EOB.
   - Ben: run the perf/latency experiments and cost model, include environment details and kernel/quant settings. Deliverable due: 2027-04-21 EOB.
   - Sergio (me): coordinate results, produce short slide (2–3) and meet with your engineering team on 2027-04-22 to walk through.

Attachments: eval_prompt_set_v1.csv (CSV, 40 prompts) — thanks for sending.

If that plan looks good, I'll kick off the runs today and loop back with progress updates.

Best,
Sergio
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@cloudwave.ai>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-19T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up and next probes after today's demo

Sounds good — thanks for the clear breakdown. A couple of clarifications:

- For hallucination detection, we can supply a small adjudication spreadsheet (we'll mark ground truth for 20 prompts) — that will help calibrate definitions. We'll share that by EOD today.
- On cost: include both streaming-enabled and streaming-disabled runs; our current deployment uses streaming and that affects tokenization and payload shape for us.
- On the mapping: HX told us hx-a2 is roughly comparable to rwd-medium in most of their internal docs, so your mapping matches our understanding.

Please proceed. We'll plan for the 04/22 walkthrough; can you propose a 30-min slot morning PT?

— Liam
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-19T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: CloudWave probe run — immediate actions and artifacts to gather

Marissa / Ben — moving this internal so we have a clean audit trail of who owns what. Summary + next actions:

Marissa (quality)
- Run Liam's eval_prompt_set_v1.csv and our internal regression_set_2027Q1. Produce: raw outputs (CSV + outputs folder), adjudication table (CSV) and one-page summary highlighting any prompts where Redwood produces hallucinations that are materially different from HyperscalerX. Use the adjudication guidance that Liam will send; if any ambiguity, flag for Sergio.
- Notes: emphasize entity/date-sensitive prompts and record answer confidence if model provides it.

Ben (perf/cost)
- Run latency bench for tokens=32 and tokens=512 at 30 rps sustained; include burst test (60 rps for 2 minutes). Produce p50/p95/p99 numbers and memory/GPU utilization traces.
- Include a cost model: show Redwood per-1k token cost for baseline and for 8-bit quantized execution, and estimate monthly cost at 100M tokens.
- Capture kernel/quant settings and whether KV cache prefixing was used.

Artifacts to include in shared Drive folder:
- raw_outputs_cloudwave.zip (CSV + text outputs)
- perf_traces_cloudwave.zip (csv + flamegraphs)
- eval_prompt_set_v1.csv (original)
- cloudwave-demo-notes.pdf (short notes for context)

Timing: both deliverables due 2027-04-21 EOB. I'll consolidate and draft a 2-slide recap for the 04/22 walkthrough.

If anything blocks (access, HubSpot record, or need for additional probes), call it out ASAP.

Thanks — Sergio
--- End of thread ---
